Flagship project Full-stack application

MediaVault

A production-deployed application for securely organizing photos and videos with private cloud storage, protected albums, and authenticated access.

  • Built the complete media workflow—from uploads and album organization to favorites, moves, reordering, and deletion.
  • Designed a React frontend, Node/Express API, and PostgreSQL/Prisma data layer with JWT authentication.
  • Deployed across Vercel, Railway, and AWS using private S3 storage and presigned URLs.
  • React
  • Node.js
  • PostgreSQL

  • AWS S3

Cloud Infrastructure Project
